teamDivider.description: Deal cards, move members and check team balance. Save rosters for your next gathering.

whatIs.title: What is Team Divider?
whatIs.description: A tool to fairly distribute participants into teams. Supports random, balanced (skill-based), and captain draft modes for sports, group projects, team-building events, and more.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Enter names and choose today's attendees while keeping the full roster.
Choose 2–8 teams and Random, Balanced or Captain Draft. For Balanced, set each person's skill from 1 to 5.
Finish revealing cards or drafting, then move, swap or lock members.
Undo or redo up to 20 team edits and share the current result as text, TXT, an image or a link.

tips.title: Tips
items: In Captain Draft, team captains take turns choosing members.
Balanced mode aims to reduce differences in team skill totals. Check actual team sizes and skill totals in the result.
If copying fails, select the complete result manually, retry, or download the same text as TXT.
A new team edit after undo clears redo history. Current skill values and the next division mode stay separate from history.

items.a: Enter up to 200 participants. Choose 2–8 teams, with no more teams than today's attendees.
Without locked members, team sizes differ by at most one. Manual moves or several locked members on one team can create a larger difference.

items.q: Can I split teams by skill?
items.a: Choose Balanced and set each participant's skill (1-5). Stronger players are assigned first to the team with the lowest skill total, which keeps totals close. Players with the same skill are shuffled, so redividing gives a new mix.

rosters.title: My group rosters
rosters.hint: Save up to 10 rosters with names, skills, team count and mode in this browser. Clearing site data deletes them.
rosters.name: New roster name

rosters.loaded: Names, skills, team count and mode loaded. Divide teams again when ready.
rosters.storageFailed: Could not read or save rosters. Check browser storage and settings.
rosters.invalidMembers: Use at least as many participants as teams, up to 200. Names must be unique and up to 80 characters.
rosters.full: You can save up to 10 rosters. Replace or delete an existing one first.
rosters.duplicate: A roster with that name exists. Use another name or select it to replace it.

board.title: Interactive team board
board.hint: Drag a card, or select a member then choose a team. Select two members from different teams to swap them.
board.selected: {name} selected — choose a team or another member to swap.
board.lockHint: Locked members keep their team when reshuffling. This may create unequal sizes or skill totals. Starting a captain draft clears locks.
board.inputHint: Up to 200 members, 80 characters each. Bulk import removes duplicate names.
board.shareHint: Shared links and images include participant names and teams. Skill balance is an approximation based on the ratings you enter.

rotation.title: Next team assignment
rotation.description: Use the current teams as the previous round and try to repeat fewer teammate pairs. Locked members stay on their teams.
rotation.captainHint: Choose Random or Skill-balanced mode to create the next teams automatically.
rotation.rosterMismatch: The completed teams must match the current roster and team count. Divide teams with the current settings first.
rotation.previousPairs: Of the {count} teammate pairs in the previous assignment, we count those still on the same team now.
rotation.skillBaseline: Chosen from candidates with a skill-total gap of {count} or less, using a standard balanced assignment with the same settings as the baseline.
rotation.lockedLimit: Keeping locked members on their teams made a size gap of one or less impossible. Unlock some members for more even team sizes.
rotation.editedHint: The repeated-pair count reflects the teams after your manual changes.
rotation.limitHint: Compares up to {count} candidates against the previous assignment only. Zero repeats or an optimal arrangement are not guaranteed.
rotation.sessionHint: This comparison clears on refresh. Shared links include only the current teams.

backup.title: Roster backup and restore
backup.description: Back up saved rosters as JSON and add only the ones you need. Names, skills, team count, and mode are included. Current teams and locks stay unchanged.
backup.previewHint: Only checked rosters will be added to the saved list. Conflicts get new IDs, with final titles shown below. Load a roster separately to use it for the current teams.
backup.emptyFile: This backup contains no saved rosters.
backup.imported: Added {count} rosters to the saved list. Current inputs and team results are unchanged.

status.duplicate: Identical content is already present; excluded.
status.conflict: ID or title conflict · select to add a separate roster.

errors.tooLarge: Roster backups must be no larger than 2MB for import or export.
errors.wrongFormat: This is not a ToolHub team roster backup. Choose a JSON backup downloaded from this panel.
errors.unsupported: This backup version is unsupported. Existing saved rosters are unchanged.
errors.corrupt: Roster data could not be read, so the original data was preserved. Check the backup or saved list.
errors.invalid: Roster information is invalid. No changes were made.
errors.unavailable: The file or browser storage is unavailable, so the action could not finish.
errors.quota: There is not enough storage space. Existing rosters and the current teams are unchanged.
errors.conflict: Another tab or action changed the saved rosters. Reload the saved list and select the file again.
errors.limit: You can save up to 10 rosters. Select fewer items or delete an unneeded saved roster. No partial import is performed.
errors.emptySelection: Select at least one roster to add.

attendance.title: Today's attendees
attendance.hint: Unchecking excludes a person from this assignment only. Saved, updated, and backed-up rosters keep every member and skill rating.
attendance.resetHint: Changing attendance clears the current teams, locks, and undo history. Attendance is kept only on this screen.
attendance.notEnough: {count} attendees cannot form {teams} teams. Add attendees or reduce the team count.

history.scopeHint: History restores team assignments and locks. Current skill ratings and the next division mode stay unchanged.
history.hint: Undo or redo the last 20 team edits. Changing the roster, attendance, or team count resets this history.
